mapper.select: SELECT um.id, um.type, um.content, um.is_read AS isRead, um.create_time AS createTime, um.note_id AS noteId, um.comment_id AS commentId, CASE WHEN LENGTH(n.title) > 30 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(n.title, 30), '...') ELSE n.title END AS noteTitle, su.nickname AS senderName, su.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM user_message um LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON um.sender_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN note n ON um.note_id = n.note_id WHERE um.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY um.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE user_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE user_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id IN #{id}
